p: month the children of Israel were: Meaning, the seventh.
confessed: They confessed their sins, and used prayers.
swelled not: Though the way was tedious and long.
divide them into corners: Meaning, the heathen whom he drove out.
testified against them to turn them: Taking heaven and earth to witness that God would destroy them unless they returned, as in 2Ch 24:19.
rest: He declares how God's mercies always contended with the wickedness of the people, who always in their prosperity forgot God.
withdrew the shoulder: Which is a sign taken from oxen that shrink at the yoke or burden in Zec 7:11.
hear: When you admonished them by your prophets.
kings of Assyria unto this day: By whom we were led away into captivity and have been appointed to be slain, as in Es 3:13.
done right: He confesses that all these things came to them justly for their sins, but he appeals from God's justice to his mercies.
testify against them: That you would destroy them, unless they would return to you, as in Ne 9:26.
fruit thereof and the good thereof: That is, to be the Lord's.
a sure covenant: Thus by affliction they promise to keep God's commandments to which they could not be brought by God's great benefits.
